title: CIRCULAR # 041: Instructions Regarding Mobile Phone Usage by Students
issued_by: Dr. P. Rajkumar, Director - IQAC, KGiSL Institute of Technology
summary: Mandatory campus-wide guidelines strictly prohibiting mobile phone usage during lecture and laboratory hours across all academic blocks. Strict adherence enforced by faculty and HODs starting Tuesday, September 8, 2026.

title: CIRCULAR # 040: Intimation of Education Loan Mela for Higher Semester Students
issued_by: Director - IQAC, KGiSL Institute of Technology
summary: Coimbatore District Administration Education Loan Mela organized at PSG College of Technology on September 17, 2026. Higher semester students requiring fee loans can register via the official Google Form.

title: CIRCULAR # 038: Intimation of Introduction of New Campus ERP (Digiicampus)
issued_by: Director - IQAC, KGiSL Institute of Technology
summary: Official migration from legacy E-Campus to 'Digiicampus' ERP effective September 1, 2026. All academic tracking, attendance, fee management, and student profiles are transitioned to Digiicampus.

title: Government of Tamil Nadu - Directorate of Technical Education - PG Abroad Scheme 2026-27
issued_by: Directorate of Technical Education (DOTE), Chennai / HOD Cyber Security
summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹36 Lakh per annum per student for pursuing full-time, on-campus Master's degrees at approved QS-ranked foreign universities for eligible government school/polytechnic alumni.
